'''Calimondretta Control''' was a transport agency tasked with controlling the entries and exits of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Calimondretta]], the largest settlement on [[Syned]] and the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Arkadianate]]. Prior to the [[Siege of Calimondretta]], the mercenary leader [[Jarrow Rusher]] hijacked an [[Icecrawler/Legends|icecrawler]] [[Crawler One]] and used it to carry two artillery cannons for the attack on Syned. He managed to evade Calimondretta's security by claiming to carry passengers from the troopship [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|''Diligence'']].
